notes.title: WINTER SALE! Discounts for YOU!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318694/83839842a854b3e89ecb06c25d02394ee3f69403.png[/img]


Feel free to change your wallpaper to something interesting. This is the best time to download my unique designs at such a low price.


[h1]Hello everyone and we wish you a Happy Holidays and an awesome 2024.[/h1]

My name is Greg and I am the founder of 3DM whose goal was to design and release unique designs as wallpapers on the Steam platform...and we did it. :D

3DM is not a company with offices and a team. 3DM has never had external financial support. I created 3DM as a single person who used my own funds to employ freelancers who coded my crazy ideas for you. I thank them very much for their support.

Despite everything, we managed to publish 14 projects that appeared on many screens around the world. Countless problems, sleepless nights, sweat and tears. Over time, we got better and the designs were improved thanks to the support of players. Thanks to your support. Thank you with all my heart.

As a thank you and on the occasion of the Winter Steam Sale, we are publishing big discounts for those who have just discovered my designs. I highly encourage you to try it and to support the micro developer.

[h3]I wish you a lot of health and joy with your loved ones.[/h3]

[h3]I wish 2024 to be better for everyone![/h3]

[h3]Big love and thanks for support. <brofist>[/h3]

[b]Best wishes,[/b]
Greg 3DM

notes.title: Support 3DM during the Summer Sale.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318694/bd56238aa89e0e5861abd8f35a7f0d1e1d5c38a3.png[/img]


[h2]Hi All,[/h2]

3DM is a family-owned company that decided to do something different on Steam than everyone else. My little son, the hero for whom I created 3DM, is the driving force.

Interactive wallpapers created on the normal Unity 3D engine turned out to be a bigger problem than we expected. Years of hard work and interesting ideas have allowed full working support for Windows designs as 3D interactive wallpapers.

Investments in good programmers turned out to be the key to success for 3DM to finally start earning money for itself. :)

Unfortunately, some time ago Steam changed the display of programs on the main page, which significantly reduced the reach of 3DM. Imagine, your family business goes down 80% in one day. :(

Nevertheless, we have developed many unique designs that will go down in Steam history as 3DM is the only publisher of 3D interactive wallpapers worldwide. No one else in the world has created continuous 3D interactive wallpapers.

That's why I strongly encourage you to support family 3DM by buying our designs at the Summer Sale. This is a great time to get our designs at a great price.

Thank you for your support!

[h2]Best Regards,[/h2]
[b]3DM Greg[/b]

notes.title: Full Release !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318694/c4ab04506e8bd6cfa5241134e4082ca11288af7d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone.[/h1]

[h2]A nice little monkey who will train you for the tournaments has just been published as the full version.[/h2]

We have improved the mechanics.
We fixed the bugs.
We added new content.

All these thanks to your support and exciting ideas.

Desktop Monkey will continue to be developed so if you have any ideas I would love to hear them.

Thank you for all your support.

Enjoy :D

3DM

notes.title: The new challenge is now ready.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318694/fb7cf6474bcdb6218a7e0eae0310d6f17f980ee8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Our newest game DESKTOP MONKEY is now available.[/h2]

Take part in tournaments for which a little monkey who will live on your screen will prepare you.

The game is demanding, so you have to develop and use new and better techniques of cutting food.

We have prepared thematic trainings and a tournament for you and your best results will be visible on the global Steam lists.

We've been working on this game a lot of time but we are a small group of enthusiasts so we decided to release the game in Early Access.

Amendments and new tournaments with new tables will be added periodically. New content coming soon.

Please report any bugs here on Steam or on our Discord under the DESKTOP MONKEY category.

[b]OUR DISCORD LINK:[/b]
https://discord.com/invite/ttU6CjSP

[h2]Thank you for all your support. Thanks to you, this game has been greatly improved and now it will only get better. Thank you.[/h2]

If you want to support a tiny team, please take part in the competition and achieve high results.

[h2]Who will be the best? [/h2]

Good Luck!

3DM Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318694/257243daad7758f340073b34df18c9120f0f20a9.png[/img]

notes.title: OPEN WEEK BETA TEST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318694/6996db37b0638a79b94455c1e00e1a04f3c53a40.jpg[/img]

[h2]We invite everyone to the open Beta Tests of our new game DESKTOP MONKEY.[/h2]

In this game, Malpka will train us for tournaments so that we can achieve the best places on the Steam Leaderboards list.

Do you want to join the beta testing for free and help us improve when it's pre-premiere?

[h2]Join our DISCORD and in the group, "desktop-monkey-beta-tests" write that you are willing to join the tests. In a private reply, you will get a free key.[/h2]

OUR DISCORD LINK:
https://discord.com/invite/ttU6CjSP

[h2]Please fill out the form with questions about the game.[/h2]
In the main menu of the game, you will find a button that will show you a google form to fill out. There you will find basic questions about the game. You can also write your own opinions there.

[h3]Anyone can participate in the free tests.
The number of free keys is limited.
Tests end on November 30, 2021. [/h3]

Good luck in testing and thank you for your support!

Best Regards.
3DM

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318694/257243daad7758f340073b34df18c9120f0f20a9.png[/img]
